events.headline: Maduro asserts diplomatic immunity in US court, seeks dismissal of charges
events.summary: Former Venezuelan leader Nicolás Maduro, who was abducted by US forces during a military attack on Caracas in January, is asserting immunity in a US court and urging dismissal of charges against him.

events.headline: Israeli settlers and forces kill two Palestinian teenagers in West Bank village raid
events.summary: Two Palestinian teenagers were killed in an attack by settlers and Israeli forces on the West Bank village of al-Mughayyer, amid continued violence in the West Bank.

events.headline: Trump claims US control of Strait of Hormuz, suggests renaming it 'Trump Strait' amid Iran war
events.summary: Amid renewed US-Iran fighting and near-daily attacks on ships in the Strait of Hormuz, Trump said the strait is under US control and suggested renaming it 'Trump Strait.'

events.headline: Zelensky urges airlines to avoid Russian airspace as Ukraine escalates drone operations
events.summary: Ukrainian President Zelensky said airlines should avoid Russian airspace as Ukraine escalates drone operations, noting Chinese and Gulf state airlines are still using Russian airspace. Russia said it will intensify its own attacks on Ukraine.

events.headline: US-Venezuela oil deal for 65 billion barrels of crude sparks controversy
events.summary: A US oil deal involving 65 billion barrels of Venezuelan crude has puzzled analysts and angered many Venezuelans. A former envoy labeled the deal a colonialist 'fever dream.'

events.headline: EU and France summon Russian envoy over failed Leipzig drone attack
events.summary: The EU's foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas said an attempted drone attack at Leipzig had 'all the hallmarks of state-sponsored terrorism' and announced the EU was summoning a Russian envoy. France announced a similar diplomatic step.

events.headline: Germany blames Russia for attempted explosive drone attack at Leipzig airport targeting Ukrainian cargo plane
events.summary: German investigators believe an explosives-laden drone deliberately targeted a Ukrainian cargo aircraft at Leipzig/Halle airport in early August. The German government said on Tuesday it held Russia 'responsible' for the attempted attack.

events.headline: Iran fuel crisis deepens as war damage and US sanctions squeeze supplies
events.summary: Long lines at fuel stations are spreading across Iran as war damage, import constraints and new US sanctions squeeze fuel supplies.

events.headline: US-Iran hostilities resume amid wave of misinformation on social media
events.summary: US-Iran hostilities have flared up again with strikes resuming, accompanied by a wave of online misinformation using old and unrelated videos falsely presented as footage of new attacks on American bases in the Gulf.

events.headline: Zelensky warns Russian airspace unsafe due to Ukrainian drone strikes, Putin accuses Ukraine of 'state terrorism'
events.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky warned that Ukrainian drones would make Russia's airspace 'completely unsafe' for the duration of the war. Russian President Vladimir Putin accused Ukraine of 'state terrorism' in response.

events.headline: Iran fires on Gulf neighbors after US strikes in resumed six-month US-Iran war
events.summary: Iran fired on its Gulf neighbors in retaliation for U.S. strikes, after a monthlong lull in what has become a six-month war between the U.S. and Iran. The conflict has spiked oil prices, disrupted the global economy, and created political challenges for President Trump's Republican Party ahead of November midterm elections.

events.headline: US airstrikes on Iran hit wedding, killing five and wounding 67, Iranian officials say
events.summary: The U.S. military conducted a night of intense strikes against Iran, described as retaliation for recent attacks on U.S. forces and marine traffic. Iranian officials said the strikes hit a wedding in a small town, killing five people and wounding 67 others; a weapons expert and visual analysis identified the bomb as American.

events.headline: Israeli FM warns Iran against attacking Israel, accuses Tehran of pursuing nuclear weapons
events.summary: Israel's Foreign Minister Gideon Sa'ar, addressing the resumed U.S.-Iran fighting, warned that any Iranian attack on Israel would trigger a 'severe' response. He accused Iran of continuing to pursue nuclear weapons aspirations and said Israel would not allow Iran to acquire them.

events.headline: Russian and Ukrainian strikes on Black Sea ports threaten global grain supply
events.summary: Strikes on ports and vessels by both Russia and Ukraine in the Black Sea have left farmers facing ruin and threaten to cause another worldwide food shock, according to reporting.

events.headline: US increasingly bogged down in Iran as war flares up again despite Trump's dominance claims
events.summary: The United States appears increasingly bogged down in its six-month conflict with Iran as fighting flares up again, despite President Trump's earlier declarations of military dominance. Trump is reportedly returning to a familiar playbook, including discussion of the Strait of Hormuz.

events.headline: US-Iran war continues as Trump floats renaming Strait of Hormuz 'Trump Strait'
events.summary: Fighting continued in the Strait of Hormuz between US and Iranian forces, with Iran having effectively shut the waterway. President Trump suggested renaming the strait 'Trump Strait' while asserting US control over it.

events.headline: US sanctions on Iran force cancellation of English proficiency and graduate exams for students
events.summary: New US sanctions measures on Iran have led to the cancellation of English proficiency and graduate exams needed for Iranians seeking to study abroad. The measures are isolating Iranians who sought educational ties with the wider world.

events.headline: European allies push back on Trump's tariffs and Iran war at G20 summit
events.summary: At a G20 summit meant to showcase President Trump's economic policies, European allies complained about US tariffs and the war with Iran. The summit, framed as a model for global economic policy, instead exposed friction between the US and its allies.

events.headline: Canada's Carney tells Trump officials to 'stop throwing shade' amid trade war, wins special elections
events.summary: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney pushed back against US Trump administration officials during ongoing trade war tensions over tariffs. Amid the dispute, Carney's Liberal party swept three special votes and polling showed strong support for him and his retaliatory tariffs against the US.

events.headline: US export controls push Chinese tech IPOs toward Beijing's strategic 'chokepoint' sectors
events.summary: A report found that years of US export controls have reshaped China's technology sector, concentrating IPO activity in areas where Beijing seeks to reduce reliance on foreign technology. About 20 percent of companies listing on Shanghai's Star Market are in these strategic chokepoint areas.

events.headline: Trump touts US AI lead over China ahead of Xi's Washington visit amid rising inflation and oil prices
events.summary: US President Donald Trump claimed the US holds a significant AI lead over China and said he was 'thrilled' about Chinese President Xi Jinping's upcoming visit to Washington. Trump's comments came as inflation and oil prices reportedly rise.

events.headline: Iran attack on Saudi oil tanker Sidr in Strait of Hormuz kills two Filipino sailors
events.summary: Saudi Arabia said an Iranian attack on the oil tanker Sidr, owned by state shipping company Bahri, killed two Filipino seafarers. The vessel was one of two supertankers carrying Saudi oil hit late Monday while transiting the Strait of Hormuz, amid the ongoing US-Iran war.

events.headline: SCO adopts first declaration on nuclear security amid renewed attacks on Iran
events.summary: The Shanghai Cooperation Organisation issued its first dedicated declaration on nuclear safety and security, condemning attacks on peaceful nuclear facilities. The document was adopted Tuesday at the bloc's 25th anniversary summit amid tensions over Iran's nuclear programme.

events.headline: Japan plans to transfer aging warships to Philippines and Indonesia to counter China
events.summary: Japan is planning to transfer aging warships to the Philippines and Indonesia, a move observers say could deepen regional security ties and help Tokyo counterbalance Beijing's growing influence. The transfers fit into Japan's broader security assistance toolkit to strengthen regional partners.

events.headline: EU trade officials in Beijing press China to fix trade imbalances before October deadline
events.summary: A European Commission delegation led by trade enforcement chief Denis Redonnet held talks with Chinese officials in Beijing seeking a diplomatic resolution to trade tensions before an October deadline set by Brussels. The talks aim to avert a looming trade war between the EU and China.

events.headline: India's economy grows 7.8% in Q1 despite oil price shock from US-Iran war
events.summary: India's economy grew 7.8 per cent in the April-June quarter, stronger than expected, bolstering analyst confidence it can sustain 8 percent growth despite high oil prices caused by the US-Iran war. India remains the world's fastest-growing major economy.

events.headline: Putin rules out talks with Ukrainian 'terrorists' as Russia intensifies strikes on Kyiv
events.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin said at a 3 a.m. news conference he won't deal with Ukrainian 'terrorists,' while praising US mediators, as Moscow intensified strikes on Kyiv. The remarks suggested Putin sees little chance of a deal to end the war in Ukraine.

events.headline: Russia deploys jet-powered drones overwhelming Ukraine's air defenses
events.summary: Russia is attacking Ukraine with jet-propelled drones, straining Kyiv's air defense capabilities and forcing continued adaptation in the drone-warfare arms race defining the war.

events.headline: Germany blames Russia for August drone attack on airport, announces countermeasures
events.summary: German officials said an August 4 drone attack attempt on an airport was carried out by Russia as part of a campaign to undermine European support for Ukraine. Germany announced countermeasures in response.

events.headline: Unconfirmed PLA Naval Exercise Reports Near Taiwan Surface on Chinese Forums
